front: Describe Ladder Diagram (LD), the IEC 61131-3 PLC programming language.
back: A graphical language that draws the program like the circuit diagram of relay logic hardware.
excerpt: Ladder logic has evolved into a programming language that represents a program by a graphical diagram based on the circuit diagrams of relay logic hardware.

front: Which IEC 61131-3 language draws the program as a diagram modelled on the circuit diagrams of relay logic hardware?
back: Ladder Diagram (LD), also called ladder logic.
excerpt: Ladder logic has evolved into a programming language that represents a program by a graphical diagram based on the circuit diagrams of relay logic hardware.

front: Describe Function Block Diagram (FBD), the IEC 61131-3 PLC programming language.
back: A graphical language that builds a function from elementary blocks, with input and output variables wired to the blocks by connection lines.
excerpt: A function is described as a set of elementary blocks. Input and output variables are connected to blocks by connection lines.

front: Which IEC 61131-3 language describes a function as elementary blocks, joined to its input and output variables by connection lines?
excerpt: The function block diagram ( FBD ) is a graphical language for programmable logic controller design, that can describe the function between input variables and output variables.

front: Describe Structured Text (ST), the IEC 61131-3 PLC programming language.
back: A high-level, block-structured textual language whose syntax resembles Pascal, the language it is based on.
excerpt: It is a high-level language that is block structured and syntactically resembles Pascal , on which it is based.

front: Which IEC 61131-3 language is a high-level, block-structured text language with Pascal-like syntax?
excerpt: Structured text , abbreviated as ST or STX , is one of the five languages supported by the IEC 61131-3 standard, designed for programmable logic controllers (PLCs). It is a high-level language that is block structured

front: Describe Sequential Function Chart (SFC), the IEC 61131-3 PLC programming language.
back: A chart language that splits a process into steps with actions, linked to each other by transitions that carry logic conditions.
excerpt: Main components of SFC are: Steps with associated actions; Transitions with associated logic conditions; Directed links between steps and transitions.

front: Which IEC 61131-3 language programs a process as steps with actions, linked by transitions that carry logic conditions?
excerpt: Main components of SFC are: Steps with associated actions; Transitions with associated logic conditions; Directed links between steps and transitions.

front: Describe Instruction List (IL), the IEC 61131-3 PLC programming language.
back: A low-level textual PLC language that resembles assembly.
excerpt: It is designed for programmable logic controllers (PLCs). It is a low level language and resembles assembly
